packageRules.description: SvelteKit and its adapter declare each other as peers: a kit major and an adapter major arrive as one PR, or neither installs.

TypeScript 7 is a from-scratch native rewrite (ships as platform-specific binaries instead of a single npm package) and isn't a safe drop-in yet — Renovate itself couldn't even produce a working lockfile for it. Revisit once the toolchain (svelte-check, eslint) has caught up.
